title: Reading Rail
user: A reader with dyslexia or visual crowding who needs to keep their place in dense browser text and review one manageable line or paragraph at a time.
smallest_useful_product: A browser extension with a movable focus rail, dimmable surroundings, per-site text-spacing presets, and optional browser text-to-speech for the current line.
success_measure: In a timed proofreading test, users retain their place after an interruption at least 25% more often than with their ordinary browser view.
constraints: No content upload or analytics by default
Keep native selection, links, and screen-reader behavior intact
Support reflow and WCAG text spacing
